name: UAL 182 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your aircraft call sign is UAL 182, you are at the holding point of Runway 04, call Wuhan Tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的航空器呼号是 UAL 182，在跑道 04 等待点，呼叫武汉塔台，报告准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 182, holding point of Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 182，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: UAL 182, behind CSN Boeing 777 on short final, line up behind. Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 182，跟在短五边的 CSN Boeing 777 后进入 Runway 04 等待。
cards.referenceText: behind CSN 777 on short final, line up behind Runway 04, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟在短五边的 CSN 777 后进入 Runway 04 等待，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, when airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞。
cards.referenceText: When airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne and passing 200 meters, call Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 200 米，呼叫武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 182, airborne, passing 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 182，已离地，通过 200 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, after passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: After passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are in London Control area, FL350, you encountered volcanic ash, tell ATC the situation and request descent, call London Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在伦敦管制区，飞行高度层 350，遭遇火山灰，向 ATC 报告情况并请求下降，呼叫伦敦管制。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we encountered volcanic ash at FL350, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们在 FL350 遭遇火山灰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: UAL 182, turn right heading 300, descent to FL290.
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 300, descent to FL290, UAL 182.

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC you are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, both engines flamed out, make a Distress call and request land at the nearest airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，双发熄火，发出遇险呼叫并请求在最近机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, London Control, UAL 182, both engines flamed out, request land at the nearest airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，伦敦管制，UAL 182，双发熄火，请求在最近机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 340.
B: 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent, tell ATC the situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启，告诉 ATC 当前情况。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, what's your intention?
B: Tell ATC you still need to land at the nearest airport because the running engine is not stable.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 182，你的意图是什么？
B： 告诉空中交通管制，由于仍在运转的发动机不稳定，你仍需在最近的机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, request landing at the nearest airport because the operating engine is unstable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，由于仍在运转的发动机不稳定，请求在最近的机场着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, continue descent to 9000 feet, expect to land at Beatle airport.
B: Tell controller you are not familiar with Beatle airport. Request airport information.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 182，继续下降至 9,000 英尺，预计在 Beatle Airport 着陆。
B： 告诉管制员你不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场资料。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, continue descent to 9000 feet. We are not familiar with Beatle Airport; request airport information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，继续下降至 9,000 英尺。我们不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场资料。

cards.audioText: Tell ATC you are able to land at this airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉空中交通管制，你能够在该机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we are able to land at this airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们能够在该机场着陆。

cards.audioText: UAL 182, continue descent to 5000 feet and contact approach 121.3.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 182，继续下降至 5,000 英尺，联系进近 121.3。
cards.referenceText: continue descent to 5000 feet and contact approach 121.3, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 5,000 英尺，联系进近 121.3，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Approach, tell them your emergency situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：联系进近，告知他们你的紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, we encountered volcanic ash, both engines flamed out, 1 engine was successfully restarted but not stable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，我们遭遇火山灰，双发熄火，1 台发动机已成功重启但不稳定。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, roger your situation. RWY is at your 2 o'clock, 10 miles, report airfield in sight.
B: Tell ATC you see the airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 182，收到你的情况。跑道在你 2 点钟方向、距离 10 英里，看到机场后报告。
B： 告诉空中交通管制你已看到机场。
cards.referenceText: London Approach, UAL 182, airfield in sight.

cards.audioText: B: Tell Approach you need emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉进近你需要应急服务在跑道附近待命。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, request emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，请求应急服务在跑道附近待命。
